_about: Coordinate overrides for the 50-state ESG layer (scripts/build-esg.ts), applied only when neither the Census geocoder nor an OpenStreetMap building match places the row.
Key = 'Company|Facility/Site Name' exactly as in the workbook. address must equal the sheet's 'Street Address|City|State Code|ZIP' or the build fails.
The point must come from an authoritative record (county auditor parcel, municipal address point) and cite it. Never an interpolation or a hand-placed pin.

Alphabet Inc. (Google)|New Albany Data C.method: Licking County Auditor parcel point (ParcelsLabels layer) for the site address
Alphabet Inc. (Google)|New Albany Data C.why: Address confirmed by the City of New Albany and the New Albany Chamber (Alula, 2026-09-03). Census returns No_Match: a coverage gap, not a bad address. Same record as data/summit/stewardship-curation.json.
